consumers.name: GoreeCloud Manager
consumers.visualAcceptance: application-specific review required for material interface changes
consumers.notes: Manager has an explicit repository-local Glaze UI 1.3.0 Stable contract. Its recorded reviewed revision remains a valid version-specific consumer anchor; stabilization governance does not require automatic repinning to every compatible documentation-only main commit.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Website
consumers.visualAcceptance: preserved for the recorded 1.1 adoption; material changes require renewed manual review
consumers.notes: The public website intentionally remains on an older Stable Glaze UI release. This is permitted by the Stable consumer-compatibility policy and must not be treated as automatic migration debt.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Tasks
consumers.notes: The active repository was reviewed for a dedicated Glaze UI conformance record during this audit; no version-specific repository-local contract was established from the reviewed README/docs surface. This is an evidence gap, not a non-conformance finding.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Notes
consumers.notes: The native Notes repository is initialized for original application development, but the reviewed repository surface does not yet establish a version-specific Glaze UI consumer contract.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Monitor
consumers.notes: The native Monitor repository is under active development, but the reviewed repository surface does not yet establish a version-specific Glaze UI consumer contract.
